LanguageData.Lumen_LuniteStabilizer_StabilizesDesc: Links to one Solar or Warp active-effect fixture, toggled on or off. Collectors and arrays cannot be linked. Draws no energy.
LanguageData.Lumen_LuniteStabilizer_LinkRadiusDesc: Measured to the nearest cell of the fixture. Links are matched across the whole map, closest pairs first, so the build order does not matter.
